misconfigurations.scenario: Customer-managed symmetric KMS key has automatic key-material rotation disabled
misconfigurations.alert_criteria: A customer-managed symmetric encryption KMS key with AWS_KMS origin is enabled and GetKeyRotationStatus reports KeyRotationEnabled=false
misconfigurations.recommendation_action: Enable automatic key rotation after confirming application compatibility and the organization's rotation period
misconfigurations.recommendation_description_detailed: Automatic rotation limits the lifetime of cryptographic key material while preserving the KMS key identifier used by applications. Evaluate only eligible customer-managed symmetric encryption keys; AWS-managed, asymmetric, HMAC, imported-material, custom-key-store, and pending-deletion keys require different lifecycle controls.
misconfigurations.output_notes: Report the key ARN, manager, origin, state, and rotation status only. Never return key policy documents or cryptographic material.
misconfigurations.notes: AWS-managed keys rotate automatically and are not findings for this rule.
